user.title: Luxor
user.description: Connect a FXLuminaire Luxor controller (ZD, ZDC or Luxor 2) on your local network.

data_description.host: IP address or host name of the controller, e.g. 192.168.1.50

error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to the controller.

data.coalesce_extinguish: Switch all groups off with one command

data_description.send_interval: The Luxor protocol allows one switching command per second. Increase this if commands get lost.
data_description.request_timeout: Each request is tried up to 3 times. Increase this for controllers on a weak Wi-Fi connection.
data_description.coalesce_extinguish: When every group is switched off at once (for example by a light group), send a single "all off" command instead of one command per group.
